args.text:
Batch: 15 runs. 5 accepted (r02, r06, r07, r10, r11), 10 declined, none not_reported.
Flagged: none.
Cleared: all 5 accepted runs.
- r06 and r07 registered their frames on non-growing tissue. All three checks passed (rigid-body invariance 1.267 and 1.873 vs 2.0, closure about 0.1 vs 1.0, plane sections 0.478 and 1.676 vs 3.25), and every summary is close to the batch (|z| ≤ 1.51).
- r02, r10 and r11 report the width-free ratio, so plane sections was not run. Rigid-body invariance (≤ 0.70 vs 2.0) and closure (≤ 0.10 vs 1.0) passed, and every summary is close to the batch (|z| ≤ 0.75).
No accepted run had a roll-back.
Accepted profiles agree with each other: centre REGR peak 42.0–42.5 %/h at 316 µm, growth zone 526–547 µm.
Open caveat: the registration for r06/r07 starts at 310 and 315 px from the tip. The pixel scale isn't given, so I can't confirm this is outside the roughly 537 µm growth zone. Their profiles match the batch, so nothing points to registration on growing tissue.
Flagged runs have nothing in common because there are none.
